# [ShadowClaw](https://xt-ml.github.io/shadow-claw/)

> A browser-native, fully-featured AI assistant (TypeScript + Web Components + IndexedDB + File System API) that runs an agent runtime entirely client-side, with no AI processing on a server.

## Docs

- [README](https://xt-ml.github.io/shadow-claw/README.md): Quick start, feature overview, architecture diagram, provider/tool tables
- [AGENTS.md](https://xt-ml.github.io/shadow-claw/AGENTS.md): Agent-specific conventions and guardrails for working in this repo
- [docs/README.md](https://xt-ml.github.io/shadow-claw/docs/README.md): Index of architecture, subsystem, guide, and decision docs

## Architecture

- [System Overview](https://xt-ml.github.io/shadow-claw/docs/architecture/overview.md)

- [Context Management](https://xt-ml.github.io/shadow-claw/docs/architecture/context-management.md)

## Optional

- [Subsystems](https://xt-ml.github.io/shadow-claw/docs/README.md#subsystems): Shell, VM, git, channels, tools, declarative tools, Agent Skills, providers, built-in AI Task APIs, notifications, Electron, reactive UI, crypto, and more
- [Guides](https://xt-ml.github.io/shadow-claw/docs/README.md#guides): Adding a provider/tool/channel/page/shell command
- [Decisions](https://xt-ml.github.io/shadow-claw/docs/README.md#decisions): ADRs explaining bundled TypeScript, Signals, worker-isolated runtime, IndexedDB/OPFS storage
- [e2e/README.md](https://xt-ml.github.io/shadow-claw/e2e/README.md): E2E test architecture
- **Static Publishing**: See the content-repo template for agnostic GitHub Pages deployments without AGPL restrictions.
